gaps.summary: Hermes needs a context window of at least 64K (MINIMUM_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000). The template sets model.ollama_num_ctx=65536 and Hermes sends extra_body.options.num_ctx=65536, but Ollama 0.16.1's /v1 endpoint ignores it: /api/ps reports context_length=4096 after a direct /v1 probe that passed options.num_ctx=65536. Hermes therefore believes it has 64K while Ollama serves 4K, and silently truncates any prompt over 4096 tokens. The non-GUI smoke prompts (about 2.6K-2.9K tokens) fit. A computer-use turn (Driver tool schema plus AX tree or screenshot) will not.
remedies_need_owner_decision: (a) Run ollama create for a derived tag with 'PARAMETER num_ctx 65536' on the 11434 server. This writes a small manifest under the system store via the daemon, so it is a /var write and was not done.

(b) Point the lane at a user-local Ollama under /mnt started with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=65536 and pull qwen2.5:3b or qwen2.5:7b there (1.6T free on /mnt). This conflicts with the 'use 127.0.0.1:11434' rule.
(c) Add a Hermes provider that calls native /api/chat, which honours options. That is new integration code and out of scope.

gaps.summary: The 11434 server runs models on CPU: /api/ps size_vram=0 for qwen2.5:3b and qwen2.5-coder:7b, and nvidia-smi lists no Ollama compute process (841 MiB of 12288 MiB used). Latency from this lane would be CPU latency, not RTX 3080 Ti latency. Nothing was timed.

computer_use_tool.driver_resolution: resolve_cua_driver_cmd() in tools/computer_use/cua_backend_driver.py uses the HERMES_CUA_DRIVER_CMD env var (explicit override, used verbatim when it is a path). Otherwise it asks PM: pm.installed_package('cua-driver').binary under HERMES_HOME. There is no config.yaml key for the path. The MCP spawn command comes from '<driver> manifest' -> mcp_invocation, falling back to '<driver> mcp'. Runtime contract min 0.20.0 (mcp --socket/--grant, serve ..., stop --socket).
